title: Bitcoin 2021 double-peak to 2022 markdown
purpose: Test the combined M24 state around a first top, correction, second top and subsequent markdown without assuming Elliott, Wyckoff, RSI or Fibonacci is causal on its own.

questions: How high were momentum and participation?
What did leverage and cross-asset context show?
What narrative dominated?
Was selling voluntary or forced/liquidation-driven?
Where did support and liquidity form?
Did the meaning-world narrative change as fast as flow?
Did price retest or exceed the prior top?
Was RSI/momentum stronger or weaker than at the first top?
Did volume/flow confirm?
Did cross-asset context confirm?
Which Fibonacci extension/retracement zones overlapped?
What did Elliott and Wyckoff describe at this point?
What did the visible bullish narrative imply?
What did underlying flow/positioning imply?
Was there a false breakout, liquidity sweep or narrative lag?
Is mechanism visible while intent remains unknown?
Which structural support failed?
Was the break confirmed by volume, volatility, leverage or cross-asset stress?
Would M24 have changed from WAIT to DOWNSIDE candidate only after confirmation?
What happened after 1d, 3d, 5d, 20d and 60d?
What was maximum adverse excursion and maximum favorable excursion?
Which signal combinations added predictive value?
